final: WITH filtered_films AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate, rental_duration FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99), per_rating_avg AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_ratio FROM filtered_films GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS mean_value FROM per_rating_avg) SELECT pa.rating, pa.avg_ratio, pa.avg_ratio - om.mean_value AS difference FROM per_rating_avg pa CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE pa.avg_ratio > om.mean_value ORDER BY pa.rating
